description: This Python script encrypts a firmware image with AES-256-CBC, prepends a structured header containing device info and versioning, computes a CRC32 checksum and appends it to the output file. It is used for preparing encrypted firmware images for OpenWrt devices, specifically tailored for certain models and regions.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses input arguments, performs AES encryption of the input file in blocks, constructs a header with device info, encrypts the firmware image, computes CRC32 checksum, and writes the final encrypted image with checksum to output file.
